description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Dark 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Maester Mode] and [20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Dark 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Maester Mode
description.text: Casts Dangerous Thoughts when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering six times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: 20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 20% for the next attack
